Aussie banks forecast record house price falls (up to 10%); CBA reports home loan applications down 15% since budget
Iron ore sector faces structural shakeout masked by geopolitical conflict; Macarthur clears WA bulk test hurdle
Bathla construction collapse signals broader housing/construction sector stress; ratings agencies flag Victoria's soaring debt
Commodity ETFs lead 2026 performance (oil, broad baskets); TMK Energy gas rates surge on Mongolian drilling
ASIC launches whistleblower review at Big Four accounting firms; CBA/Westpac face scrutiny over loyalty pricing loopholes
Nvidia reaffirms AI boom intact; skilled migrant priority shifts to AI workers and tradies
EV sales overtake petrol cars in Australia as fuel costs soar; energy transition costs mounting

sectors.trend: Under pressure from rising rates, falling house prices, and 15% drop in home loan applications. CBA and Westpac face regulatory scrutiny over pricing practices. ASIC whistleblower review adds overhang.
sectors.implications: NIM compression risk as loan growth stalls; credit loss provisions likely to rise. CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX face margin pressure. Defensive dividend yields remain attractive but capital returns may be curtailed.

sectors.trend: Iron ore shakeout underway but obscured by war-driven demand. Macarthur (MAC.AX) clears WA bulk test. Small-caps (Kaoko, Vanadium Resources, Piche) outperform. Aurum adds West African gold ounces. Commodity ETFs lead 2026.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face medium-term iron ore price pressure. Gold (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) and uranium/vanadium names offer diversification. Small-cap explorers (BRS.AX, SLM.AX, PWR.AX) show momentum but carry elevated risk.

sectors.trend: TMK Energy gas rates surge on Mongolian drilling. Beetaloo (BTL.AX) flagged to challenge gas cartel. Energy transition costs mounting. EV adoption accelerates as fuel costs rise.
sectors.implications: BTL.AX, WDS.AX, GWO.AX benefit from gas price strength. Oil-linked names supported by Iran war. EV transition pressures traditional fuel demand long-term.

sectors.trend: Bathla collapse signals systemic construction stress. Housing construction to follow prices lower. 10% house price falls predicted. Melbourne councils admit infrastructure cannot cope with population growth.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, SPG.AX) face occupancy and valuation pressure. Construction names (WTC.AX, CGC.AX) under stress. Residential REITs most vulnerable.

sectors.trend: Nvidia confirms AI boom intact. Skilled migrant policy prioritises AI workers. Data centre opposition persists. Solana 'token supercycle' narrative.
sectors.implications: ASX tech exposure limited but global AI capex supports hardware/electrical names. CSL.AX (biotech/health tech) benefits from AI-driven drug discovery. Domestic tech remains thin.

sectors.trend: Wendy's dividend cut signals consumer softness. Ozempic maker in trouble; tablet alternatives emerging. Ambulance delays linked to patient deaths in Darwin.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from input costs. CSL.AX, SGH.AX, OSH.AX remain defensive anchors. Consumer staples under pressure from inflation.

Iron ore structural shakeout masked by geopolitical demand
Construction sector fragility (Bathla) as systemic risk indicator

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration exposure; favour short-dated bonds and floating-rate instruments. Overweight dividend-paying financials with strong capital buffers.
Underweight residential REITs and construction. Monitor CBA loan pipeline data weekly. Hedge via inverse housing ETFs.
Maintain energy and gold hedges. Monitor oil prices and AUD/USD. Keep 10-15% cash allocation.
Avoid leveraged construction and property developers. Monitor ASIC and ASIC whistleblower outcomes.
Diversify materials exposure beyond iron ore; favour gold, uranium, and critical minerals.
Favour gas producers (BTL.AX, GWO.AX) over renewables capex-heavy names. Monitor policy shifts.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and critical minerals names
opportunities.rationale: Commodity ETFs lead 2026; gold hedges rate risk and geopolitical uncertainty. Aurum adds ounces; small-caps showing momentum.

opportunities.recommendation: Add gas producers on rate surge
opportunities.rationale: TMK Energy gas rates surge; Beetaloo positioned to challenge cartel. Gas provides inflation hedge and energy security premium.
CBA, NAB offer 7%+ yields; rate hikes support NIM short-term despite loan growth slowdown. Strong capital positions.
Healthcare/defensive; AI-driven drug discovery tailwind; Ozempic disruption creates tablet opportunity. Resilient through rate cycle.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce residential REIT and construction exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: 10% house price falls forecast; Bathla collapse signals sector fragility; loan applications down 15%. High downside risk.
Structural shakeout underway; war-driven demand is temporary. Diversify to gold, uranium, critical minerals.
Fourth RBA hike imminent; rate volatility elevated. Preserve capital for potential housing-driven dislocation entry points.
Wendy's dividend cut signals margin compression; input costs rising; consumer spending under pressure from fuel and housing costs.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure into Q4 2026. Fourth RBA hike and Iran war reescalation keep rates elevated. Housing data (10% falls, 15% loan drop) will weigh on financials and REITs. Gold and gas provide relative strength. Expect volatility around RBA decisions and geopolitical headlines.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if rate cycle peaks. 'Bull case returns' narrative gains traction. AI capex cycle and commodity strength (oil, gold) support select sectors. Housing correction may create entry points by mid-2027. Energy transition and critical minerals offer structural growth. Key risk: prolonged housing downturn triggering broader credit stress.
